one_liner.zh: 追踪 DSH Web 会话文件修改并提供逐行审查与撤回。
one_liner.en: Review and revert file changes made during DSH Web sessions.

local: Runs in the DSH Web profile and uses its local web server.
Reads and writes project files when a user invokes revert.
Persists review records in the DSH profile state file.

completeness.reason: Host implements write/edit tracking, session and turn summaries, line diffs, persistence, and guarded revert paths.

code.reason: Host and UI are separated; tracking, persistence, routes, and merge failures have explicit handling, though the JavaScript is untyped.

docs.reason: README documents installation, usage, revert behavior, color settings, persistence, capacity limits, and turn bucketing.

maintenance.reason: The repository has 19 commits, but its listed latest push was 2026-08-17, over 30 days before this analysis.
